title: Cross-microservice PII registry (ADR-0156)
description: Aggregated personal-data classification index per ADR-0156. Source-of-truth is each µservice's manifest.json#data_classes_processed; this file is the by-data-class inverse-index for DSR (Data Subject Request) cascade and GDPR Art. 30 evidence. Per ADR-0008 data-use-boundary the canonical class taxonomy is shared with data/core/boundary-kernel.

PII_IDENTIFYING.description: Directly identifying personal data — full name, email, phone, government id.

PII_QUASI_IDENTIFYING.description: Quasi-identifying data — locale, timezone, device id, IP address.

PII_SENSITIVE.description: Sensitive personal data — biometric, demographic, behavioral.

AUTHENTICATION.description: Authentication secrets — passwords, tokens, OAuth refresh tokens, OIDC subjects.

INTERNAL_ONLY.description: Internal infra / engineering data (no personal data).

dsr_cascade_contract.description: DSR (Data Subject Request) cascade target list. When a user invokes delete/export/access, the cascade fans out to every µservice listed in the per-data-class arrays above.
